content.text:
Set up. Summary:

- `cargo init` created the `winapi_tool` binary crate (edition 2024).
- `winapi = "0.3.9"` added under `[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]` with a starter feature set (`winuser`, `memoryapi`, `handleapi`, `errhandlingapi`, `winerror`, `processthreadsapi`) — trim/expand features as you use more of the API surface.
- `src/main.rs` demonstrates a direct binding (`MessageBoxW` + `GetLastError`), with everything Windows-specific gated behind `#[cfg(windows)]` and a `compile_error!` on other targets so a non-Windows build fails immediately with a clear message instead of confusing type errors.
- Verified: native build on this Linux box fails fast with just the intended error; cross-compiling with `cargo build --target i686-pc-windows-gnu` succeeds.

Note: `winapi` itself is effectively unmaintained (frozen at 0.3.9 in favor of the `windows`/`windows-sys` crates) — fine since you asked for it specifically, but worth knowing if this becomes long-lived.
